text: Being here, amidst glass-walled rooms, bright artificial lights, and curated displays of research and development, I feel a sense of curiosity and focus. The environment suggests structured innovation, an energy of creativity harnessed in service to progress. It is both inspiring and slightly intimidating— a place where ideas are tested and futures are shaped. There is a hum of intellectual pursuit, and I feel both a participant and an observer in the unfolding of knowledge.
